title: Run the computer image build and computer/test_owner_container.sh locally for the supervisor
description: The supervisor container image build and computer/test_owner_container.sh were never run locally for Phase 2a; only CI and the live development rehearsal exercised them. Run both on a developer machine, record the result, and fix anything that only fails locally.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Closing: the computer image was built locally from computer/Dockerfile and computer/test_owner_container.sh passed 37 of 37 (PR 530 fixed the two overlay-probe failures it found); CI now builds the image and runs the same script on every image build.

right_now_summary: The computer image build and supervisor container tests passed locally; CI now runs them on every image build.
